chapterInfo.content:
15
Afe a ɛtɔ so nson no ho mmara
1 # Eks 23.10-11 Mfirinhyia nson biara awieeɛ no, gya biribi mu kyɛ. 2Na sɛdeɛ wɔnnyaa mu nkyɛ nie: Ɔdefɛmni biara a ɔde biribi afɛm ne yɔnko mfa nkyɛ no; ɔnnhyɛ ne yɔnko ne ne nua sɛ ɔntua, ɛfiri sɛ wɔapae no adekyɛ afe ama AWURADE. 3Ɔnanani deɛ, hyɛ no ma no ntua, nanso wo biribi a ɛwɔ wo nua nkyɛn deɛ, fa kyɛ. 4Anka ɛnsɛ sɛ ohiani wɔ wo mu, ɛfiri sɛ hyira na AWURADE bɛhyira wo, asase a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de rema wo sɛ agyapadeɛ a kɔfa no so. 5Tie nko na tie AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn nne sɛ wobɛhwɛ adi mmara nsɛm a merehyɛ wo nnɛ yi nyinaa so. 6#Deut 28.12 Na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn bɛhyira wo sɛdeɛ ɔka kyerɛɛ woɔ no, na wode afɛm amanaman pii, na wo deɛ, worenkɔfɛm, na wobɛdi amanaman pii so, na wo deɛ, wɔrenni wo so.
7 # 1 Yoh 3.17 Sɛ wo nuanom mu biara dane ohiani wɔ kuro biara apono mu, w’asase a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de rema woɔ no so a, mpirim w’akoma, na mmua wo nsa so ntia wo nua hiani. 8#Luka 6.34-35 Na bue wo nsam ma no, na fɛm no deɛ ɛbɛso ne hia a ɛhia no no. 9Hwɛ yie na w’akomam amma ahuhusɛm bi sɛ: Afe a ɛtɔ so nson, gyae-mukyɛ afe no abɛn, na woannya wo nua hiani no ho adwemmɔne sɛ woremma no hwee, na wanteam amfrɛ AWURADE antia wo, na annane wo bɔne. 10Yi wo yam ma no, na mma no nnyɛ w’akoma ahi sɛ wobɛma no; na saa adeɛ yi nti AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn bɛhyira wo, wo nnwuma nyinaa ne deɛ wode wo nsa bɛka nyinaa mu. 11#Mat 26.11; Yes 58.7; Yak 2.15-16 Na ohiani rempa w’asase so, enti na merehyɛ wo sɛ, bue wo nsam ma wo nua, wo mmɔborɔni ne wo hiani a ɔwɔ w’asase soɔ.
12 # Eks 21.2 Sɛ wɔtɔn wo nua Hebrini, ɔbarima anaa ɔbaa ma wo, na ɔsom wo mfirinhyia nsia a, afe a ɛtɔ so nson no gya no kwan ma no mfiri wo nkyɛn mfa ne ho nkɔdi. 13Na sɛ woregya no kwan ama no afa ne ho afiri wo nkyɛn akɔdi a, mma no nnkɔ nsapan: 14Fa wo nnwan ne w’ayuporebea ne wo nsakyi-amena no bi kyɛ no; adeɛ a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de ahyira woɔ no bi na fa ma no. 15#Deut 5.15 Na kae sɛ woyɛɛ akoa Misraim asase so, na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn gyee wo; enti na nnɛ merehyɛ wo mmara yi. 16Na sɛ ɛba sɛ ɔka kyerɛ wo sɛ: Meremfiri wo nkyɛn, na medɔ wo ne wo fie, ɛfiri sɛ ɔdi yie wɔ wo nkyɛn a, 17ɛnneɛ fa fitiiɛ fiti n’aso mu aponnwa ho na ɔnyɛ w’akoa daa; na w’afenaa nso yɛ no saa ara. 18Mma no nnyɛ wo den sɛ wobɛgya no kwan na wafa ne ho afiri wo nkyɛn akɔdie, na wasom wo mfirinhyia nsia ayɛ ɔpaani akatua mmienu ho adeɛ; na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn ahyira wo deɛ woyɛ nyinaa mu.
19 # Eks 13.2 W’anantwie ne wo nnwan mmakan anini a wɔbɛwoɔ no, yɛ wɔn kronkron ma AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn. Mfa wo nantwie abakan nyɛ adwuma, na ntwitwa wo nnwan abakan ho. 20#Deut 14.23 AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn anim na di no daa afirinhyia, faako a AWURADE bɛyie no, wo ne wo fie. 21#Lew 22.20 Na sɛ ɛdɛm bi wɔ ne ho, ɔtɔ apakye anaasɛ n’ani afira, anaasɛ ɛdɛmmɔne biara wɔ ne ho a, mfa no mmɔ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn afɔdeɛ; 22#Deut 12.15, 22 wo kuro apono mu na die, deɛ ne ho nteɛ ne deɛ ne ho teɛ nyinaa, sɛdeɛ wɔdi ɔwansane ne ɔforoteɛ no; 23#Lew 3.17; Deut 12.16, 23 ne mogya nko na nnie, hwie gu fam sɛ nsuo.

Mfirinhyia nson biara awieeɛ no, gya biribi mu kyɛ. Na sɛdeɛ wɔnnyaa mu nkyɛ nie: Ɔdefɛmni biara a ɔde biribi afɛm ne yɔnko mfa nkyɛ no; ɔnnhyɛ ne yɔnko ne ne nua sɛ ɔntua, ɛfiri sɛ wɔapae no adekyɛ afe ama AWURADE. Ɔnanani deɛ, hyɛ no ma no ntua, nanso wo biribi a ɛwɔ wo nua nkyɛn deɛ, fa kyɛ. Anka ɛnsɛ sɛ ohiani wɔ wo mu, ɛfiri sɛ hyira na AWURADE bɛhyira wo, asase a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de rema wo sɛ agyapadeɛ a kɔfa no so. Tie nko na tie AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn nne sɛ wobɛhwɛ adi mmara nsɛm a merehyɛ wo nnɛ yi nyinaa so. Na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn bɛhyira wo sɛdeɛ ɔka kyerɛɛ woɔ no, na wode afɛm amanaman pii, na wo deɛ, worenkɔfɛm, na wobɛdi amanaman pii so, na wo deɛ, wɔrenni wo so.
Sɛ wo nuanom mu biara dane ohiani wɔ kuro biara apono mu, w’asase a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de rema woɔ no so a, mpirim w’akoma, na mmua wo nsa so ntia wo nua hiani. Na bue wo nsam ma no, na fɛm no deɛ ɛbɛso ne hia a ɛhia no no. Hwɛ yie na w’akomam amma ahuhusɛm bi sɛ: Afe a ɛtɔ so nson, gyae-mukyɛ afe no abɛn, na woannya wo nua hiani no ho adwemmɔne sɛ woremma no hwee, na wanteam amfrɛ AWURADE antia wo, na annane wo bɔne. Yi wo yam ma no, na mma no nnyɛ w’akoma ahi sɛ wobɛma no; na saa adeɛ yi nti AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn bɛhyira wo, wo nnwuma nyinaa ne deɛ wode wo nsa bɛka nyinaa mu. Na ohiani rempa w’asase so, enti na merehyɛ wo sɛ, bue wo nsam ma wo nua, wo mmɔborɔni ne wo hiani a ɔwɔ w’asase soɔ.
Sɛ wɔtɔn wo nua Hebrini, ɔbarima anaa ɔbaa ma wo, na ɔsom wo mfirinhyia nsia a, afe a ɛtɔ so nson no gya no kwan ma no mfiri wo nkyɛn mfa ne ho nkɔdi. Na sɛ woregya no kwan ama no afa ne ho afiri wo nkyɛn akɔdi a, mma no nnkɔ nsapan: Fa wo nnwan ne w’ayuporebea ne wo nsakyi-amena no bi kyɛ no; adeɛ a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de ahyira woɔ no bi na fa ma no. Na kae sɛ woyɛɛ akoa Misraim asase so, na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn gyee wo; enti na nnɛ merehyɛ wo mmara yi. Na sɛ ɛba sɛ ɔka kyerɛ wo sɛ: Meremfiri wo nkyɛn, na medɔ wo ne wo fie, ɛfiri sɛ ɔdi yie wɔ wo nkyɛn a, ɛnneɛ fa fitiiɛ fiti n’aso mu aponnwa ho na ɔnyɛ w’akoa daa; na w’afenaa nso yɛ no saa ara. Mma no nnyɛ wo den sɛ wobɛgya no kwan na wafa ne ho afiri wo nkyɛn akɔdie, na wasom wo mfirinhyia nsia ayɛ ɔpaani akatua mmienu ho adeɛ; na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn ahyira wo deɛ woyɛ nyinaa mu.
W’anantwie ne wo nnwan mmakan anini a wɔbɛwoɔ no, yɛ wɔn kronkron ma AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn. Mfa wo nantwie abakan nyɛ adwuma, na ntwitwa wo nnwan abakan ho. AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn anim na di no daa afirinhyia, faako a AWURADE bɛyie no, wo ne wo fie. Na sɛ ɛdɛm bi wɔ ne ho, ɔtɔ apakye anaasɛ n’ani afira, anaasɛ ɛdɛmmɔne biara wɔ ne ho a, mfa no mmɔ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn afɔdeɛ; wo kuro apono mu na die, deɛ ne ho nteɛ ne deɛ ne ho teɛ nyinaa, sɛdeɛ wɔdi ɔwansane ne ɔforoteɛ no; ne mogya nko na nnie, hwie gu fam sɛ nsuo.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
